short_description: Standalone evolutionary ecosystem research: grow ecology from landscape/history without player or biome species tables, then later transfer and continue the same ecology inside the world simulator.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology mini-project that evolves plant and later multi-trophic ecosystems from causal environment/resource/competition/history rules, exports portable spatial ecology state, and eventually feeds World Generation/local/background simulation without duplicate ecology truth.
current_stage: ECO.EVO1 / P2.8 Deterministic Save/Restart Plant World Proof / Repaired Candidate / Exact Windows Rerun
progress_note: P2.1-P2.7 remain accepted; the latest exact-Windows P2.8 attempt repeated the complete parent chain through P2.7 successfully, then P2.8 returned an empty experiment result. The defect was isolated to the P2.8 JSON checkpoint codec: Godot JSON parsing erases integer Variant type unless explicitly tagged, while canonical checkpoint hashes distinguish TYPE_INT and TYPE_FLOAT. Repair dc910baa78c5b68f606210a7bd60fe9e5cc0d4f1 adds an explicit Int wrapper only. 31fd42a503875247cc758b36d7915a99a6a72698 adds a codec regression and 8d5de417f83ac257ee3bc1ae40c02847ac82de82 makes it a fail-fast runner preflight. Same-engine attached Linux double probes reproduce the original int-to-float defect and pass the repaired codec/two-cut 14->18->30 flow in three fresh processes. Exact Windows acceptance is still pending.
last_accepted_checkpoint: ECO.EVO1/P2.7 Lineage Divergence / Speciation Candidate Diagnostics
next_stage: Rerun RUN_ECO_EVO1_P2_8_TESTS.ps1 on exact Windows checkout.
